sloka: इदम् पंच अप्सरो नाम तटाकम् सार्व कालिकम् ।निर्मितम् तपसा राम मुनिना माण्डकर्णिना ॥३-११-११॥
transliteration: idam paṁca apsaro nāma taṭākam sārva kālikam ।nirmitam tapasā rāma muninā māṇḍakarṇinā ॥3-11-11॥

translations.english: O Rama this lake called Panchapsara filled with water at all times has been created through penance by a sage called Mandakarni.
